description: This is the main HTML file for a web-based database visualizer interface. It contains the structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript code to display connected databases, tables, and data with dynamic fetching and interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets the current selection, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and displays it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for data table from the data fetched.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML based on the data type, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content to show full data.
